classification.difficultyReason: Calculate the depreciated value, compare it with the sale price, and interpret the dollar difference.

content.prompt: The Northern Start Bus Company bought a bus for $\$480000$, depreciated it at $30\%$ p.a., and sold it again seven years later for $\$60000$. Was the price that they obtained better or worse than the depreciated value, and by how much? Give your answer to the nearest cent.

answer.short:
Better by $\$20469.94$.

The sale price exceeds the value obtained using seven years of depreciation.
answer.worked:
$$\begin{align*}V_7&=480000\times(0.70)^7\\V_7&=\$39530.064\\\text{Excess sale price}&=60000-39530.064\\\text{Excess sale price}&=\$20469.936\\\text{Excess sale price}&\approx\$20469.94\end{align*}$$

The price obtained was better than the depreciated value by $\$20469.94$.
